title: Coefficient restriction preserves the strict localization arrows
statement: Let i:Z↪T be a closed immersion, U its complementary quasi-compact open immersion on the small pro-etale site, and φ:B→D a compatible map of inverse sequences of commutative ring sheaves. Supply both exact localization data P:SequenceData(i,U,B) and Q:SequenceData(i,U,D). Then ScalarCompatibility(i,U,B,D,φ,P,Q) [def-sp-semilinear-open-closed-data] is inhabited. This consists only of the four operation/scalar comparisons, the actual section identities for open restriction and closed direct image, and preservation of the actual open counit and closed unit. Existence and exactness of P,Q are hypotheses, and no flatness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03CZ, 03DI and 03CY; coefficient inverse image also uses proetale.tex Tag 09A5. Parent proof steps 2, 3 and 7.

proof.text: For open restriction and closed direct image use identity additive section maps. Their actions agree by the coefficient square and naturality of the ring unit. Induction on adjacent coefficient squares identifies both coefficient routes B_m→D_n, proving horizontal naturality and the section normalizations.

Inverse image restricts the action by the inverse image of φ while retaining the underlying abelian inverse image; the resulting invertible comparison preserves the actual module unit, since that adjunction is the abelian adjunction with these actions.

The open comparison is identity on every additive extension-presheaf summand and is then sheafified. Composition coherence makes it commute with system transitions. Agreement on all summands and uniqueness of sheafification prove preservation of the actual open counit. Transport along the given open adjunctions by uniqueness of left adjoints. Together these constructions give all fields of ScalarCompatibility. Naturality at differentials gives its termwise complex interpretation.

theorem semilinearLocalizationScalarCompatibility
    {T Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (U : T.ProEt) [IsOpenImmersion U.hom] [QuasiCompact U.hom]
    (hU : Set.range U.hom = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (B D : ℕ → Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n) (σ : ∀ n : ℕ, D (n + 1) ⟶ D n)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, B n ⟶ D n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ (n + 1) ≫ σ n = τ n ≫ φ n)
    (P : SequenceData i U B τ) (Q : SequenceData i U D σ) :
    Nonempty (ScalarCompatibility i U B D τ σ φ hφ P Q)
